prompts.name: 01-tunnel-overview
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Blender-to-Roblox environment concept for the existing game BACKROOMS: STAY QUIET.
The supplied images are REAL current lobby screenshots, serving as geometry/palette references, not finished-art targets. Create a polished, buildable revised version of THIS SAME LOBBY. Keep a very long enclosed semicircular road tunnel, aged mustard/olive yellow concrete, black structural arch ribs, black asphalt with yellow dashed center line, raised broad side sidewalks and restrained cyan lighting. Roughly 280 studs long, 70 wide, 35 high; central road only 33 wide. Six side level entries in three paired rows stay in place. Detailed but readable mid-poly Blender game art, believable 90s backrooms transit/service infrastructure, not a real-world photo and not a generic futuristic nightclub. More detail in geometry silhouettes/materials, not random clutter. Subtle wear, concrete form seams, convincing metal brackets, cable trays, conduit junctions, vents and clean lighting housings. No sky, daylight, water, luxury materials, rainbow RGB, heavy fog, giant LED screens, horror monsters, people, logos from real festivals, HUD, floating UI, title overlays, watermark. Remove all screenshot HUD and avatar. Grounded architecture, coherent reusable assets, open walking routes.
Wayfinding language: chunky black metal gate portal housings at the SIDE doorways with warm cream/cyan bold level numbers, plus large double-sided projecting signs whose broad readable faces point down the tunnel toward an approaching player, rather than being edge-on. Keep road clear of pillars. Gate status is secondary; active1–3 cyan, sealed4–6 muted amber with small COMING SOON status (DEV access preserved as a concept constraint).
Primary request: hero wide 16:9 eye-level view from near the existing spawn, looking all the way down the full tunnel. Preserve the familiar scale and spatial order, but reimagine the tunnel with a complete high-quality Blender kit: richer black arch rib profiles with bolted base feet, aged concrete panel seams, overhead twin cable/service rails, restrained repeating cyan fluorescent fixtures, curb drainage grates and crisp worn lane paint.
Foreground paired level gates: viewer LEFT LEVEL 2, viewer RIGHT LEVEL 1, matching the real screenshot orientation. Further along LEFT LEVEL 4 and RIGHT LEVEL 3; last pair LEFT LEVEL 6 and RIGHT LEVEL 5. The projecting portal sign faces and big numbers are clearly visible from the long approach, connected to substantial side-entry gate architecture. Avoid filling the image with text; make the nearest two exact signs legible. Keep the existing compact supplies shop on viewer-left between first and second gate rows, with its row of ten subtly glowing small cube product displays.
At the far tunnel end, beyond the last gates, show a distinctly raised 90s industrial DJ booth on a stepped black deck, twin DJ decks and mixer, framed by two floor-mounted steel festival truss towers carrying stacked black line-array concert speakers. Stage is a focal point within this ordinary yellow backrooms tunnel, not an arena. Piled worn sofas, laminate desks, vinyl chairs, filing cabinets and beige CRTs form the far-end backstop behind the booth and in its wings. Keep central aisle, sidewalks and side gates open. Atmospheric cyan-and-warm-yellow balance, attractive game-art lighting with clear material readability, very long deep perspective, understated unsettling emptiness. No stage characters.

prompts.name: 05-queue-bay
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: buildable Blender-to-Roblox environment concept, revised LEVEL 3 loading/queue bay in BACKROOMS: STAY QUIET.
Input reference1 is the freshly generated and USER-APPROVED Level3 gate style: weathered mustard-yellow concrete, chunky bolted black metal doorframe, readable LEVEL 3 lintel above the side doorway, perpendicular projecting horizontal LEVEL 3 → blade sign visible down the tunnel, restrained cyan light strips. Retain this same architecture and level of game-art craft. Input reference2 is the REAL current Level3 lobby bay geometry: a broad orange 90s children's-party/backrooms room off the tunnel with multiple circular launch pads. Improve its loading-bay art while retaining the roomy side-room layout and pad circulation.
Primary scene: one wide16:9 image, eye-level diagonally looking through the Level3 gate INTO the queue bay, with the LEVEL 3 header and projecting arrow sign both visible in the left/foreground, the main tunnel sidewalk still clear and the room beyond framed by the gate. No fake HUD, title overlay or watermark.
Show a beautiful detailed but grounded queue bay: aged saturated burnt-orange wall panels, worn muted party-pattern carpet inset around thick black circular launch plinths, matching industrial cyan details, modest readable station displays. Three or four separated queue pads with generous walking space; no clutter blocking entrances, not a military loading dock. 90s institutional/backrooms feel, not a sterile sci-fi facility.
One prominent occupied queue pad has JUST STARTED a queue: a crisp thin cyan hologram ring glowing around its floor perimeter, from which a TRANSLUCENT VERTICAL CYLINDER OF LIGHT rises roughly chest-to-head height. The cylinder wall is brightest at its bottom edge and smoothly FADES UPWARD TO COMPLETE TRANSPARENCY, with a very faint scan-line texture. It is hollow, you can clearly see the room and two simple friendly Roblox-blocky avatar silhouettes through it. No opaque top lid, no solid wall, no closed cage, no forcefield sphere, no thick spiraling beams, no lasers. The top boundary dissolves softly rather than forming another hard ring. Show the fade gradient unmistakably. Low bloom, no flashing or heavy particles; warm room materials stay visible around and through the effect. The avatars serve only to communicate scale/queue, neutral simple clothes, no detailed faces or horror character.
Other pads are EMPTY / INACTIVE: only a dim floor-ring outline, absolutely no raised cylinder. One small physical station sign near the active pad can read QUEUE ACTIVE, with clean understated type; no unrelated invented game data, counters or prices. Match the approved gate's game art, strongly readable silhouettes, local cyan floor reflection, attractive controlled lighting. Preserve distinct normal architecture and holographic queue effect. All pads are walk-through, no decorative barrier across the central route. No water, sky, rainbow RGB, smoke, nightclub décor, gore, brand names.
prompts.refinement: Owner approved lintel plus projecting arrow gate. Owner requested active-queue floor ring raising a translucent cylinder that fades upward.
